title: The worker that never sleeps
impact: Moonshot: rejected, and the mechanism works — which is what makes the rejection worth reading. Exp 284 closed nine experiments by measuring that 5.30 us of the 6.28 us write hop is the isolate boundary rather than resqlite (claim 284.1), and left one number unexplained inside it: the identical `executeWrite` costs 7.612 us on a running isolate and 9.380 us on a worker parked until the message arrived. Nobody had asked whether a worker has to idle. Dart gives a library one way to keep an isolate runnable — leave something in its event loop — and microtasks are disqualified because a microtask loop starves the receive port the request arrives on. Both remaining primitives were built on exp 284's floor writer and priced in CPU as well as wall time. The tax is real and recoverable: a worker circulating a token through its own port runs the identical C call at 8.974 us against a parked worker's 9.606 us, and with the calling isolate warmed too the isolate boundary drops from 5.117 to 4.225 us — 17% of what claim 284.1 prices. Recovering it costs more than it is worth. Warming the worker alone is +5.7% on the floor lane and +6.2% to +9.6% in the shipping path with CPU up 13-17%, at every window from 5 to 200 us across nine passes, because a request arriving mid-spin waits behind a token turn that costs 1.85 us to buy back 0.9 us; a zero-duration `Timer` loop is worse still at 6.50 us a turn and +25.0%. The only lane that wins needs the *caller* spinning, and the caller is a Flutter app's UI isolate — the main-isolate blocking exp 280 rejected a candidate for. Two findings outlive it. The boundary is substantially scheduling rather than transport, so the direction reopens only on a VM-side spin-before-park or thread-affinity knob, not on a smarter library. And the release suite's `Single Inserts (100 sequential)` row — the one public lane resqlite loses — parks its caller between writes, charging resqlite for a caller-side wake worth about a sixth of the boundary that an application issuing the same writes from a live isolate never pays. Runtime reverted; prototype at `archive/exp-285`; four lanes retained as `benchmark/experiments/worker_keep_warm.dart`.
